english_evidence: What a great riding instructor Frank is! He is Dutch, and great news for the foreigners (like me) he is also comfortable to give lessons speaking in English!!

notes: Solo eenmanszaak run by owner-instructor Frank Baeten (LinkedIn: Eigenaar Autorijschool Driezeeg, Feb 2024 - Present). Manual-only by deliberate policy: site/press state lessons are in a handgeschakelde (manual) Volkswagen T-ROC because an automaat licence restricts later manual driving; no automatic option offered. English: exactly one English-language Google/rijloket learner review states owner Frank is comfortable teaching in English (instructor himself is Dutch); no English on the school's own site, hence 'likely'/med. Founding 2024 corroborated by LinkedIn (owner start Feb 2024), rijloket 'Actief sinds 2024 (2 jaar)', and rijschool-tips 'ca. 3 jaar geleden opgericht'. New school with low first-attempt pass rate (CBR Den Bosch: 32% first-attempt over 19 exams, 49% overall; rijloket lists 30% over 20 exams). RIS-method instruction. Only 2 reviews total.
